prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / 01a1e9c1-aa21-7891-9f2b-2faff169472f
issues: 26058, 26066–26072: “weekdays, including Saturdays” conflicts with ordinary English usage, where weekdays normally means Monday–Friday. Replace with an unambiguous definition such as Monday through Saturday excluding public holidays, preserving the Italian feriali meaning. The extra Saturday claim is consistent with the municipal definition at https://www.comune.castelfranco-piandisco.ar.it/it/news/ztl-estiva-a-castelfranco-di-sopra-2050415?type=1.

prior_review_findings.author: gpt-6.1-terra / 01a1e9c1-aa21-7891-9f2b-2faff169472f
issues: 26058, 26066–26072: “días laborables” can be understood as excluding Saturday in Latin American usage, so it does not reliably convey the Italian feriali or the explicit Monday–Saturday excluding holidays in the Chinese draft. Specify lunes a sábado salvo festivos. In 26066, “días festivos, no laborables” is also ambiguous as to whether no laborables describes festivos or contrasts with them.

issues: 26061, 26062, 26063, 26064, 26065, 26066, 26068, 26071: 节假日 alone does not explicitly include Sundays, while the Chinese questions and Italian festivi include Sundays.
